emma: Heads-up: customer reported duplicate billing after a streaming session that called an external tool during a reconnect. trace: nx-2f5c

ravi: duplicate as in provisional stayed + confirmed added? or confirmed wrote twice?

emma: provisional written on router accept (estimate 118). mid-stream reconnect -> router routed to cheap-region and applied header-sanitization -> client idempotency header dropped. runtime retried the toolcall and wrote confirmed 91 tokens. ledger shows both entries. logs:
```
[nx-2f5c] router: accept provisional=118 model=red-mu
[nx-2f5c] router: route-change -> region-low (sanitize-headers=true)
[nx-2f5c] runtime: toolcall retried, client-idempotency=null
[nx-2f5c] billing: write provisional +118
[nx-2f5c] billing: write confirmed +91
```

gonzalo: two problems: header preservation and billing semantics. billing currently treats provisional as applied to balance; confirmed is additive and dedupe only works on runtime_request_id. That fails if idempotency lost.

priya: proposal: router should mint X-Session-Commit-ID at ingress and attach to downstream calls. billing treats provisional entries as "pending" keyed by session_commit_id. on confirmed with same commit id, billing replaces pending with final. if confirmed never arrives within TTL, pending expires and triggers an adjustment flow.

ravi: +1. console UX: surface a "pending tokens" column separate from invoiced balance, with tooltip "pending estimates may be adjusted when final usage is known" and a link to support. admin view should filter by large pending items.

billing-bot: note: ledger change required: add pending bucket (pending_balance) separate from invoiced_balance; new events: billing.pending.created, billing.pending.finalized, billing.pending.expired. Must plan data migration for existing provisional rows.

gonzalo: telemetry: emit router.session.commit(session_commit_id, estimate, model_hint), billing.pending.created(session_commit_id), billing.pending.finalized(session_commit_id, final_tokens). Join key = session_commit_id so we can trace end-to-end.

priya: internal API question: should router or runtime generate session_commit_id? router sees the session at ingress and survives reroutes, so router is better. runtime must accept the header if present; if absent runtime synthesizes one and billing marks as runtime-scoped. keep header optional.

emma: short-term mitigation: revert the header-sanitization rule in the canary, and add a runtime guard to reject toolcall replay when neither client idempotency header nor session_commit_id is present (fail-fast). also add a short log line emitting session_commit_id for recent sessions for triage.

ravi: quotas: provisional should reserve quota on accept to prevent burst oversubscription. finalization consumes the reservation and records actual usage; if pending expires, release reservation. sync with quota team before rollout.

gonzalo: owners/PRs: router#760 add-session-commit (@priya), billing#1108 pending-ledger (@emma), console#622 pending-ui (@ravi), telemetry#401 session-commit-events (@gonzalo). QA scenarios: route-swap with header preserved, route-swap with header lost, model fallback with lower tokenization, truncated stream with early EOF, late confirmation after TTL.

ci-bot: CI pipeline note: add integration test that asserts ledger replaces pending with finalized when session_commit_id matches and that quota reservations behave correctly.

priya: I'll open the design doc for billing pending semantics and a small canary to re-enable router session header propagation after we revert sanitization. ping here when PRs land. :thumbsup:
